<p>2. 运行结果截图：</p>
<p><img alt="联想截图_20260419121420" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3779862/202604/3779862-20260419121816304-921510167.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3.问题回答：</p>
<p>ans1：函数score_to_grade的功能是将分数转化成对应的等级 形参类型是int 返回值类型是char</p>
<p>ans2：（1）由于返回值类型为char，故应该使用' '而不是“ ” （2）缺少break，case会一直向下，最终输出结果均为E</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>实验任务2：</p>
<p>1.源代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> sum_digits(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> n) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> ans = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (n != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         ans += n % <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         n /= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ans;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> }</pre>

<p>2.运行结果截图：</p>
<p><img alt="2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3779862/202604/3779862-20260419122846292-582821369.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3.问题回答：</p>
<p>ans1：函数sum_digits的功能是计算n各个数位上数字的和</p>
<p>ans2：能实现，原代码是运用循环算法，修改代码是运用递归算法</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>2.运行结果截图：</p>
<p><img alt="3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3779862/202604/3779862-20260419123633002-25405689.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3.问题回答：</p>
<p>ans1：函数power的功能是计算x的n次幂</p>
<p>ans2：是递归函数，在n为奇数和偶数时存在递归，数学公式为：</p>
<p><img alt="3.1" width="391" height="206" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3779862/202604/3779862-20260419124615236-559270895.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>实验任务4：</p>
<p>1.源代码：</p>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (j = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; j &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> * i + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>; j++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>             printf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> O\t</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         printf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (k = n; k &gt; i; k--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>             printf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\t</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span>             printf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;H&gt;\t</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (k = n; k &gt; i; k--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
